headline: Kidnapped rare Serbian eagle freed into wild after rescue
summary: A rare Serbian eagle kidnapped after its first flight has been rescued from poachers and released back into the wild.
script: A rare Serbian eagle was kidnapped after its first flight, then ended up in the Middle East with poachers demanding a ransom. After a rescue, Feliks has now been released back into the wild.
imageAlt: A rare Serbian eagle rescued after being kidnapped by poachers.
imageAltTwo: A second eagle image connected to the rescue and release.
